34' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

32' David de Gea was forced into action to thwart Gift Orban (Verona). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot towards the roof of the net but couldn't beat the keeper.
31' Martin Frese (Verona) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but David de Gea easily deals with the threat.
30' A tremendous drive by Rafik Belghali (Verona) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but David de Gea makes a brilliant save.
29' Kieron Bowie (Verona) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
29' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) commits a rough challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Fiorentina seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
24' The Verona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
22' A nice individual effort by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
21' Antoine Bernede (Verona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Guida signals.

18' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
17' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make. Fiorentina earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
14' Fiorentina seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
12' A cross from a corner kick by Verona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.

11' Antoine Bernede (Verona) gets inside the box and tries to beat David de Gea with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. Verona force a corner. They send men into the box.
9' Rafik Belghali (Verona) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
8' None of the Verona players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.

7' Antoine Bernede (Verona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Verona can continue in their attacking effort.
